title: Amulet of Bhaal
summary: Hits against targets at maximum HP inflict Bleeding.

fields.Effect: Hitting a creature that still has all its HP inflicts Bleeding for 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 120 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Access: The amulet permits entry to the Undercity Ruins and the Bhaal Temple.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
